documents.stance_why: The page says 'Faculty have the discretion to permit, partially permit, or prohibit the use of generative AI' and offers a 'not permitted' statement and a 'permitted only as specified' statement with Levels 0-3. The document sets no single stance and hands the choice to instructors and assignments, so delegates with tiers.

documents.summary: Faculty-facing guidance with sample syllabus statements and four AI Use Levels (0-3). It makes no university-wide rule on student AI use and sets grading with AI as not approved. It sets rules for requiring tools, AI note-taking and instructor disclosure.
